Me and my family cannot recommend Fivelands enough after this week. Our cat Celini was very sick and stopped eating for over a week. We all began to fear the worst was going to happen as she’s an old girl, but Cassie, the vet, was amazing in helping us identify what was going on and wanted to go above and beyond to help Celini. She treated our cat with so much love and respect; she even brought her out to us wrapped up in a blanket like a baby as she’d brushed her after her dental surgery. We were all so frightened about what would happen to her but Cassie was so kind and the Fivelands team was so reassuring to us all. Celini is so much happier now and back to her old playful self. Thank you so much Fivelands and an even bigger thank you to Cassie! You made our family very happy.

I have all my cats registered with Fivelands in Yardley, and the service has always been excellent. Appointments run on time, the reception team are friendly and helpful, and every vet takes the time to explain things clearly. I usually see Kate with all my cats — she’s incredibly friendly, very knowledgeable, and always gives reliable advice. Prices are reasonable, and the Pet Health Club is great because it covers flea and worm treatments, so I never have to worry about budgeting for them. They were also really helpful when I brought in a stray to check for a microchip. Highly recommended.
